## Summary

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature (engine, pipeline or CLI)
- [ ] Scene, theme or reel content
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (media guard, doc links, typecheck and tests)
- [ ] If runtime, timing, scenes, audio or capture changed: rendered the affected reel(s), inspected frames and listened to the audio. Reel(s) checked: <!-- e.g. content/videos/<id>/ru.reel.yaml -->
- [ ] No videos, audio, animated GIFs, archives, rendered PDF/PPTX, model weights or generated caches are committed; every indexed file is at most 1 MiB and every documentation preview image at most 300 KiB ([media policy](https://github.com/eiler2005/Storygro/blob/main/docs/reference/media-policy.md))
- [ ] Every on-screen number comes from a data file with a quoted source (`sources.md`); no numbers typed into scene code
- [ ] `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, `COMMERCIAL.md` and the `Required Notice:` lines are preserved; third-party notices and model terms are kept
- [ ] Documentation updated (technical docs in English)
- [ ] Planned features (API publishing to social platforms, automatic analytics) are not described as working
